مقدمة
This document outlines the equipment inspection list I1, which must be carried 
 out on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the above title block.
This pump is used to reheat the water that transferred by condensate pump to 
 dearator.
The first draft initiated & tested by eng. Reda Abou El-Nasr, accepted by eng. Magdy 
 Okba, and approved by eng. Ahmed Sowan: head sector of Nubaria Power Station.
تمت مراجعة هذه الوثيقة بواسطة مهندس مراقبة الجودة. مجدي حجازيم، قبول م. سمير عبد الجليل؛ التفتيش والجودة MEPC
